Which additional N=1 supercurrent conservation laws follow from classified linearized off-shell supergravity models, and under what improvement and global-definition conditions can they be related to standard multiplets?

Clarify the relationship between the general supercurrent obtained from linearized off-shell supergravity and earlier superfield Noether constructions, and determine which multiplet the Noether procedure naturally produces for a general N=1 nonlinear sigma-model.

Classify free massless (3/2,2) off-shell supermultiplets realized by a real axial-vector superfield H, with or without compensators, and distinguish pure linearized supergravity from supergravity accompanied by propagating matter.
How can one construct a supercurrent for a general effective N=1 supersymmetric gauge theory, isolate explicit R-symmetry breaking, and identify conditions under which an R-current remains conserved?

evidence.text: Add supersymmetry-breaking mass operators, take their coefficients formally large, and require divergent parts of the superspace equations of motion to vanish. For example, −(m_y²/f²)∫d⁴θ |X|²|Y|² generates scalar decoupling; combinations of operators implement multiple component removals.

sources.title: On the origin of constrained superfields

evidence.text: Apply superspace derivatives to the constraint and project to components. The highest derivative projection determines the eliminated lowest component recursively; lower projections are treated as consistency conditions. The appendix establishes derivative identities supporting this component count.
